audit_scope: Independent offline/read-only expansion-cache recovery contract audit

frozen_production_limit.recommended_change_location: Explicit workspace cached_relay_recovery adapter and workspace construction gate only

observed_snapshot.stale_exit_note: The raw cache advanced during this read-only audit. An earlier exit=1 cannot alone justify starting a duplicate recovery job.

actual_compatibility.conclusion: Attach compatibility does not imply original unpatched recovery-chain validation or future recognize_manifest reuse compatibility.

where_to_call: After successful acquisition and before writing scene_recognition_complete.json
Before workspace run_scan200 calls unchanged production attach_cache
checks: Install/use the same explicit cached_relay_recovery eligibility predicate; validate every raw record with configured canonical request fingerprint.
Traverse every recovery archive recursively using validate_cached_request; check immutable archive SHA, frame identity, image SHA, canonical cache fingerprint and actual transport/budget provenance.
Parse successful responses and compare existing parsed/refined semantic tags to the raw parse; do not silently promote malformed responses, refusals or incomplete frames.
Before the completion gate, require the exact manifest frame list, complete scene provenance, and the expected RGB/raw hashes; incomplete acquisition remains pending.
Write a compact workspace validation receipt containing only hashes, status/code classifications and explicit adapter SHA; never output raw encrypted events or credentials.

general_explicit_retry_policy.successful_frames: Always reuse successful raw records byte-for-byte. A later failure does not justify replacing successes or restarting model/prompt/image settings.
general_explicit_retry_policy.output_budget_exhaustion: Only when the saved failure is the existing max_output_tokens predicate, explicitly pass --retry-max-output-tokens N with max(configured_budget,saved_budget)<N<=32768. Retry only the failed frame, archive the unchanged failed response, retain canonical cache_request_fingerprint and actual per-request budget. Do not pass --new-max-output-tokens unless an explicit policy for all new frames is intended. If no valid larger budget remains, stop and report that budget limit.
general_explicit_retry_policy.temporary_upstream_failure: Use a finite, explicit code/status whitelist (currently upstream_http2_stream_error/upstream_error on saved stream requests) with --retry-transport-failures and --recover-non-stream; preserve source model/prompt/budget/images and record archive hashes. Backoff and a bounded retry count should be explicit.
general_explicit_retry_policy.nonstream_upstream_failure: The current predicate still requires saved request stream=True. A subsequently saved nonstream upstream failure is not eligible. Add such a case only through an explicit, bounded, offline-tested workspace recovery policy with full archive-chain validation; do not broaden to any failed response.
general_explicit_retry_policy.authentication_quota_refusal_malformed: Keep ineligible and report required action; do not convert them to transient failures or retry without cause.
general_explicit_retry_policy.single_flight: Reuse the existing recovery/scene locks, inspect active process and current cache progress before retrying. An old exit file alone is insufficient.
general_explicit_retry_policy.root_cause_limit: The current 001320 evidence shows relay returned upstream_error. It does not establish HTTP2, proxy, image, model, quota or billing root cause. Failed billing remains unknown.

contracts: HTTP2 recovery preserves successful raw bytes and archive; original attach succeeds while original validator refuses the adapter-only recovery history.
Budget failure has no retry under transport-only flags; explicit finite larger budget succeeds, preserves original success bytes, and passes original validation.
A saved nonstream upstream HTTP2 failure is currently ineligible, produces no further mock request and remains unchanged.
